description.value: The White Rock Community Centre is a City of White Rock-operated multipurpose facility housing a fitness gym, dance studio, arts room, gallery, presentation hall, and several rentable meeting spaces. Situated on Russell Avenue in the coastal city of White Rock, it serves as the primary hub for community programs, cultural events, and recreational activities for residents and visitors. Touring cyclists passing through White Rock may find it a convenient central facility, though no cycling-specific amenities are advertised on the website.
